newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE unveils development plan; says wants to develop non-oil sector in the next five years. The plan needs capital investments of $12 billion.
- Foreign businessmen agree to contribute to eight projects worth $2.1 billion in Egypt.
- Kuwaiti and international banks compete to finance Kuwait Airways purchase of two planes worth $280 million.
